# Juan Vargas

> Juan Vargas, software engineer and Technical Lead from Montevideo, Uruguay, with about nine years in the industry. Good technical skills, and a focus on sharing knowledge, solving problems together and good communication.

## About me

I'm Juan, a software engineer from Montevideo, Uruguay. I've been working in the industry for about nine years. I started as a freelancer, went through agencies and product teams, and over time grew into leading teams.

Today I work as a Technical Lead at BuildOnline, where I lead a team of fifteen people. Before that I led smaller teams of three or four developers, often taking care of project management while still writing code alongside them.

What I enjoy most is the people side of building software. I like sharing what I know with my teammates and learning from them, working through problems together instead of alone, and making room for open, honest conversation. In my experience, good communication matters as much as the technical solution, and I try to bring both to every team I'm part of.

## What I focus on

- Building reliable products that are easy to maintain over time.
- Helping teams work well together: clear priorities, shared knowledge and space to ask questions.
- Being a bridge between what the business needs and what the team builds.

## Experience

- Now: Technical Lead, BuildOnline. Leading a team of fifteen people working for a church-tech platform.
- 2022: Team Leader, BuildOnline. Leading small teams of three or four developers, also as project manager.
- 2020: Software Developer, BuildOnline.
- 2020: Software Developer, Upwork, freelance.
- 2019: Software Developer, Light-it.
- 2018: Backend Developer, Sitios, digital agency.
- 2017: Software Developer, Freelance.

## Some of the projects I've worked on

- A content workspace for churches, built from scratch for desktop, web and mobile.
- A media library shared across several products as an embeddable package.
- A mobile app for church worship teams to plan their setlists.
- An in-store handheld app for a retail chain in the United States.
- A podcast management platform, where I had my first hands-on experience with Kubernetes.
- A marketplace for booking podcast guests.
- A vehicle sourcing platform for a car dealer.
- A payments app that passes card fees on to the customer.
- A marketplace connecting photographers with clients.
- A shift booking platform for a childcare company.
- A data tool for an agricultural association.
- A ticketing app for university events.
- An offline-first task manager for a prison in Uruguay.
- A small WhatsApp booking system for barbershops.

## Skills

- Payments and integrations: Stripe (my favorite) and many third-party APIs
- Quality and infrastructure: Playwright, Docker, GitHub Actions, and some hands-on Kubernetes
- Languages: Spanish and English
